input.quote: ARTICLE XXI EFFECT OF TERMINATION Upon termination of this Agreement: for any reason (a) the rights and licenses granted to Licensee pursuant to this Agreement will automatically terminate, and (b) Licensee shall, within five (5) days, ship to Licensor all Licensed Technology, API's Documentation with respect to the Licensed Technology and other Confidential Information in Licensee's possession or control
input.rationale: The agreement contains no post-termination transition assistance or data return/export right for us. Article XXI (Effect of Termination) is entirely one-directional: licenses cease and Licensee must ship all Licensed Technology, documentation and Confidential Information to Licensor within five days, with officer certification; nothing requires Licensor to return or export Licensee's data or to assist with migration off the hosted trading platform. Searches for "transition", "return"/"export" and data-related terms show nothing elsewhere: Article XX and Articles XXII–XXIII address change-of-control termination, right of first refusal and remedies, and the General Provisions (p0145–p0159) contain no wind-down provision. The confidentiality return-of-materials language likewise binds only Licensee. This falls below the fallback (90 days of assistance plus 30-day data export) and, absent any data-return right at all, sits close to walk-away territory. We propose inserting a new Article XXI(c) at the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at Licensor's then-current rates, return of Licensee Data within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter, with survival; 90 days of assistance is offered as a fallback in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and Licensee data return/deletion obligations into Article XXI (Effect of Termination).
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article XXI requires us to hand everything back but says nothing about getting our own data back or moving off the platform, so we have added a transition-assistance and data-return paragraph: up to six months of assistance at Licensor's then-current rates, export of Licensee Data within 30 days in a machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter. If six months is too long, we can accept 90 days of assistance with the same 30-day export.

ops.text: (c) TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND RETURN OF LICENSEE DATA. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Licensor shall (i) at Licensee's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to six (6) months at Licensor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days of such expiration or termination, return to Licensee all data, records and trade and account information of Licensee and its customers stored in or processed by the Licensed Technology ("Licensee Data") in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete Licensee Data from its systems and certify such deletion to Licensee in writing. This Section shall survive termination of this Agreement.
